description: This file manages secret target registry queries, including building indexes, resolving targets, and discovering secret targets based on configuration and registry data.

methods.name: buildTargetTypeIndex
methods.description: Builds an index mapping target types and their aliases to registry entries.

methods.name: buildConfigTargetIdIndex
methods.description: Builds an index of registry entries by their config file IDs for openclaw.json.

methods.name: buildAuthProfileTargetIdIndex
methods.description: Builds an index of registry entries by their config file IDs for auth-profiles.json.

methods.name: normalizeAllowedTargetIds
methods.description: Converts an iterable of target IDs into a trimmed set, or null if undefined.

methods.name: resolveDiscoveryEntries
methods.description: Resolves discovery entries based on allowed target IDs, default entries, and entries by ID.

methods.name: discoverSecretTargetsFromEntries
methods.description: Discovers secret targets from registry entries given a source object.

methods.name: toResolvedPlanTarget
methods.description: Resolves a plan target from registry entry, path segments, and captures.

methods.name: listSecretTargetRegistryEntries
methods.description: Returns a list of all secret target registry entries.

methods.name: isKnownSecretTargetType
methods.description: Checks if a string is a known secret target type.

methods.name: isKnownSecretTargetId
methods.description: Checks if a string is a known secret target ID.

methods.name: resolvePlanTargetAgainstRegistry
methods.description: Resolves a candidate target against the registry to find a matching plan target.

methods.name: resolveConfigSecretTargetByPath
methods.description: Resolves a secret target by its path segments.

methods.name: discoverConfigSecretTargets
methods.description: Discovers secret targets based on a given configuration.

methods.name: discoverConfigSecretTargetsByIds
methods.description: Discovers secret targets based on configuration and optional target IDs.

methods.name: discoverAuthProfileSecretTargets
methods.description: Discovers auth profile secret targets from a store.

methods.name: discoverAuthProfileSecretTargetsByIds
methods.description: Discovers auth profile secret targets from a store with optional target IDs.

methods.name: listAuthProfileSecretTargetEntries
methods.description: Lists secret target entries related to auth profiles.
